title: How JPNentry Verifies Japan-Side Supply Before You Pay
description: JPNentry is a Japan-based sourcing and verification desk for overseas buyers. Our role is not to promise that every requested item exists. content:
JPNentry is a Japan-based sourcing and verification desk for overseas buyers. Our role is not to promise that every requested item exists. Our role is to verify what can actually be sourced in Japan, under what condition, at what cost, and on what commercial terms before a buyer commits.
1. We begin with one exact requirementFor industrial parts, we ask for the exact maker, exact part or model number, quantity, destination and timing. For vehicles or other goods, we confirm the exact specification required. A specific requirement can be verified. A broad request cannot.
2. Listings are signals, not proof of supplyA public listing, old catalog page or marketplace result does not automatically mean an item is currently available. JPNentry treats those sources as leads until current availability and commercial terms are verified with the seller or supplier.
3. We verify the full cost stack before quotingBefore a buyer-facing commercial quote is treated as firm, we work to verify procurement cost, Japan domestic freight, inspection or testing where relevant, packing and documentation, international freight, payment fees and reasonable risk buffers. We do not invent freight, duties, delivery times or savings.
4. Evidence mattersFor hard-to-find industrial parts, useful evidence may include exact model confirmation, condition, available quantity, supplier identity, current price, lead time, quote validity, test or condition evidence and the date of verification. The goal is an evidence-backed option, not a guess.
5. Buyer approval comes before irreversible spendWhere commercially possible, JPNentry structures procurement so the buyer approves the verified option before JPNentry commits inventory or other irreversible spend. Supplier purchase, deposits and binding commitments are not made casually.
Start with one requirementIf you have one exact Japanese item you are trying to source, send the maker, exact model or part number, quantity, destination and timing. For obsolete or discontinued industrial parts, use the GHOST STOCK Rescue Ticket: https://form.jotform.com/262572392466061

title: Illustrative RFQ Walkthrough: A Discontinued Japanese OEM Part
description: A fictional, clearly labeled example showing how one exact overseas requirement moves from MPN and photo to verification, itemized quotation and buyer approval.
content:
Important: this is a fictional illustrative example. It contains no client data and does not claim a completed transaction. Its purpose is to show the information and decision gates used in a JPNentry sourcing workflow.
The buyer's requirementAn overseas repair business needs two units of a discontinued Japanese OEM component. It sends the manufacturer, exact MPN, a clear nameplate photo, acceptable condition, destination country and the date by which it needs a commercial answer.
Japan-side verificationJPNentry checks whether the referenced part number is exact, superseded or potentially incompatible. Current Japan-side routes are reviewed and sellers are contacted where confirmation is required. Old pages, search snippets and unverified marketplace claims are not presented as confirmed supply.
The commercial answerThe buyer receives either a Quote or a No-Go. A quote separates product cost, sourcing or verification fee, Japan domestic delivery, agreed inspection, packing, export handling and the status of international freight. Condition, quantity, payment terms and quote validity are written explicitly.
The buyer approval gateThe RFQ itself is non-binding. The buyer reviews the evidence and commercial terms. No reservation, purchase or supplier payment occurs until the buyer approves the final scope in writing and the required payment is confirmed.
After approvalJPNentry purchases through the agreed route, completes the agreed receiving or inspection steps and coordinates the defined export handover. If availability changes before payment, the quote is revalidated rather than silently substituted.
Send a quote-ready requestInclude the exact identifier, photo or URL, quantity, destination, acceptable condition, target budget and deadline. If fitment matters, include the relevant VIN, chassis or machine context.

title: What a JPNentry Quote Includes — Before You Pay
description: A clear Japan sourcing quote should separate the item, verification work, Japan-side handling, export logistics and transaction costs. Here is what JPNentry confirms before any purchase begins.
content:
A useful sourcing quote is not just one total number. It should show what has been verified, which costs are included, which costs depend on the destination, and how long the commercial terms remain valid. JPNentry does not purchase, reserve or bid on an item before the buyer gives written approval and payment is confirmed.
1. Product cost and availabilityWe identify the exact product, model, MPN, OEM reference, grade or specification requested. The quote states the Japan-side price basis, condition, available quantity and the point in time at which availability was checked. A product page or old listing is not treated as confirmed stock.
2. Japan-side sourcing and verificationThis covers the agreed work required to search, contact suppliers, compare viable routes, confirm key details and prepare a commercial recommendation. The scope depends on whether the request is a straightforward purchase, a supplier verification task or a difficult discontinued-part search.
3. Domestic handling and inspectionWhere applicable, the quote separates Japan domestic delivery, receiving, visual checks, photography, consolidation, repacking, storage or specialist inspection. The inspection level is agreed before purchase; it is not implied by the word verified.
4. Export deliveryInternational freight, insurance and export documentation depend on the item, dimensions, weight, destination, urgency and agreed delivery terms. Freight may be firm, estimated or quoted separately. The quote makes that status clear.
5. Transaction costs and validityPayment processing, currency exposure and the quotation validity period are stated so the buyer can evaluate the real commercial basis. Import duty, local tax, registration, certification and destination-side charges are included only when explicitly written into the scope.
Why exact information mattersAn MPN, OEM reference, VIN or chassis context, clear photo, quantity, destination, target timing and acceptable condition allow us to verify the correct route. Broad category requests create broad estimates; exact requirements create quote-ready answers.

content:

content:
A fast Japan-side sourcing result starts with a precise requirement. This guide shows the minimum information JPNentry needs to turn an unresolved request into a verified sourcing path, quote or no-go.
1. Start with the exact identifierFor industrial parts, send the exact manufacturer, MPN, nameplate photo, revision or machine context. For auto parts, send the OEM reference and VIN/chassis context when fitment matters. For vehicles, send the model, year, grade, fuel/powertrain and material options or specifications.
2. State the real quantityA one-piece emergency replacement and a 120-unit recurring order require very different supplier routes. Quantity determines whether retail evidence is useful or whether JPNentry must find scalable B2B supply.
3. Add destination and timingCountry, city or port and the required timing matter because freight, compliance, export documentation and lead time can change the economics. If the request is production-down or customer-committed, say so.
4. Give the target buying basis when you have oneIf you already have a target Japan buy price, CIF budget, landed budget or resale ceiling, include the amount, currency and basis. JPNentry can then reject commercially impossible routes early instead of wasting time on listings that will never close.
5. Define what cannot be substitutedList the non-negotiables: exact revision, genuine-only, tested used acceptable, mileage ceiling, color, rear entertainment, warranty, packaging, documentation or other material requirements. We do not silently substitute a materially different item.
What happens nextJPNentry checks commercially relevant Japan-side routes, normalizes evidence and verifies the current quantity, condition/spec, business cost, lead time and supplier terms. When the inputs are complete enough, we calculate the real commercial path and return a quote, a next-step sourcing option, or a clear no-go.
The fastest CTA is simple: send one exact unresolved Japan requirement through https://www.jpnentry.com/
